title: Retiring a twenty-year warehouse in a bank: inventory first, switch-off as the goal
summary: A vendor case study on a large bank decommissioning a two-decade Teradata warehouse (thousands of daily feeds, close to a thousand use cases, more than 140 reporting suites) in favour of Databricks SQL; the vendor says regulatory compliance was safeguarded and business processes were not interrupted, with more than 1,200 users to move and re-skill, while completeness and parity evidence are not visible.

sources.caveat: Search-result title and snippet only; the page itself could not be opened when this analysis was written. Reported outcomes are the reporter's claims, not reproduced results.
